comment: #494: for every explainer the product video cuts from, the sha256 of its current build (file), of its script (docs/product/scripts/explainer-NN-*.md) and of its builder (tools/media/explainers/explainer_NN.py). tools/media/compose.py refuses an explainer clip source whose file digest is not the one named here, and the plain pytest in tests/test_media_compose_sources.py goes red, naming the file, when a listed script or builder differs from the manifest — an explainer rebuilt on any host turns CI red until the manifest gets the new build (pick the clips of the scene again, then update the manifest).
